Subject: Discovery follow-up: rotating demo slots for Acme Corp

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the call earlier — great conversation and appreciate the clarity on your priority use cases (search ranking + customer support summarization). Quick recap and next steps: 

- Primary goals: reduce average query latency for internal search, and automate triage/summaries for support tickets.
- Constraints: must meet EU data residency for logs, 99.9% availability target for production endpoints, and a soft budget ceiling for inference costs.

Next step: schedule a technical demo + deep-dive with our runtime engineer to walk through integration patterns and the latency/cost tradeoffs. Because your team spans EU and APAC, I want to propose a rotating schedule so demos hit friendly times for all stakeholders rather than forcing the same region each week.

Proposed rotating pattern (30-45 min demo slots):
- Week A: 11:00 PT / 19:00 CET (good for US mornings & EU evenings)
- Week B: 16:00 CET / 00:00 SGT (EU afternoon + APAC morning next day)
- Week C: 08:00 PT / 16:00 CET / 23:00 SGT (covers US morning, EU afternoon, APAC late evening)

Can you confirm which of the following next-week windows works for your group? I can also send a calendar poll if that's easier.

Options (all 30-45 min):
- Tue 2026-11-17 11:00 PT / 19:00 CET
- Wed 2026-11-18 16:00 CET / 00:00 SGT (Thu 11/19 00:00 SGT)
- Thu 2026-11-19 08:00 PT / 16:00 CET / 23:00 SGT

Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) with owners / timelines - Aditya and Marissa are looped for technical + CS coverage. If those slots don't work, happy to propose others or we can open the Calendly link below to pick a time.

Thanks,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Acme_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf

- Week B slot (Wed 11/18 16:00 CET / 00:00 SGT) might be tricky because that’s middle of the night for Tom. He suggested the Week C option if we can push the APAC piece a bit earlier.

- Thu 2026-11-19 16:00 CET / 23:00 SGT (matches your Week C time)
